supported_claim: The exact maximum overlap between a 70-bit cyclic binary sequence and the retained 64-edge common backbone is 61. A complete finite classification proves that no valid radius-1 cover attains overlap 61, so every valid 70-bit cover has backbone overlap at most 60.
scoped_result_scope: A complete theorem for one project-derived backbone at exact length 70. It is not a new construction, a new bound on L(9,1), or a global impossibility result.
external_review_status: Pending; the public artifact explicitly requests independent mathematical review and makes no priority claim.

scoped_theorem.statement: Every 70-bit cyclic binary sequence contains at most 61 distinct edges of the retained 64-edge common backbone, no valid radius-1 cover attains 61, and every valid cover therefore has overlap at most 60.
scoped_theorem.evidence: Two full finite enumerations, semantic validation of all 188 residual flows, four complete small-instance oracles, adversarial mutation tests, retained source snapshots, and byte-for-byte replay.
scoped_theorem.limitation: The theorem does not exclude candidates with backbone overlap at most 60.
scoped_theorem.announcement_blocker: Independent external mathematical review remains pending.

global_lower_bound.blocker: Lengths 62 through 70 have not all been excluded by independently checked proofs.

benchmark_artifact.scope: Verified methods, reproduced artifacts, independently checked local DRAT exclusions, separately labeled solver evidence without proof traces, the complete exact-overlap-61 classification, and explicit limitations.
